name: What are the common costs associated with building an Airbnb-ready ADU?

mainEntity.name: What are the common costs associated with building an Airbnb-ready ADU?

acceptedAnswer.text: The common costs for building an Airbnb-ready ADU include design and architectural fees, permit acquisition costs, site preparation, construction materials and labor, and utility connections. Additionally, specific features for short-term rentals, such as a dedicated entrance, soundproofing, and durable interior finishes, may add to the overall budget. We can help you understand the potential cost range by discussing your specific project goals and desired amenities during an initial consultation, allowing for a more tailored estimate.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs for an Airbnb-ready ADU include design, permits, site work, construction, utilities, and features specific to rentals like soundproofing. Costs vary based on design and amenities.
